art_direction: 灰原短发儿童肖像抱着素面书，鼠尾草墨线背景与淡紫轮回眼衬出冷静神态。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Draw Ai Haibara in her child appearance, with a neat auburn bob and a composed small face. She holds a plain closed book low against a soft sage sweater, keeping the hands away from the face. Her gaze returns gently toward the viewer with a restrained knowing smile rather than a severe expression. Use hand-drawn ink with subtle pressure variation, flat warm-gray washes, and a single pale green background shape. Keep her body and styling age-appropriate, without adult makeup or fashion treatment. Both eyes remain unobstructed beneath the short fringe, and the book cover has no text. Give both visible irises soft violet Rinnegan rings with a clear dark pupil and bright catchlights. Keep the rings fine and contained so the gaze remains warm and readable. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
